## About today's class

This week has two parts. We begin with **Spark NLP in practice**: building on last week's annotator concepts, we'll use pretrained pipelines for Named Entity Recognition (NER) and sentiment analysis, explore LightPipeline for fast local inference, and walk through an end-to-end news article processing example that previews the lab.

We then shift to **Spark Structured Streaming** — a unified programming model that lets you write the same DataFrame code for both batch and streaming workloads. Topics include the unbounded-table model, output modes (Append, Update, Complete), stateless vs. stateful transformations, **event-time windows** (tumbling and sliding), and **watermarks** for handling late-arriving data.
